image_description: A top-down view of a dark blue, textured object resembling a compact cassette tape. The object has the general rectangular shape with rounded corners and two circular cutouts typical of a cassette. However, the surface texture is highly irregular, appearing like felt or coarse fabric rather than smooth plastic. There is a label in the center with illegible, gibberish text that mimics the layout of a cassette label but fails to render readable characters. The edges are slightly soft and bleeding into the background.
